callouts.label: Core
callouts.detail: Extremely hot and dense; nuclear fusion occurs here, converting hydrogen to helium and releasing energy.

callouts.label: Radiative Zone
callouts.detail: Energy transported outward by radiation in the form of photons; extremely dense plasma.

callouts.label: Convective Zone
callouts.detail: Energy transported by convection; hot gas rises, cools, and sinks; outer layer of the star.

callouts.label: Photosphere
callouts.detail: The visible surface of the star; where light is emitted; granules are visible due to convection.
